title: Global stabilization and finite element analysis of the viscous Burgers' equation with memory subject to Neumann boundary feedback control
summary: This paper presents a global stabilization result of the viscous Burgers' equation with the memory term by applying Neumann boundary feedback control laws. We construct suitable feedback control inputs using the control Lyapunov functional and establish stabilization in the \(L^{2}, H^{1},\) and \(H^{2}\)-norms. The existence and uniqueness of the solution are established through the Faedo-Galerkin method. Moreover, we show the global stabilization where the diffusion coefficient $ν$ is unknown.
